episode_title: Date Masamune: The One-Eyed Dragon of the North

He carved an empire before he could grow a beard. Date Masamune rose from a teenage lord to the master of northern Japan in just five years — one eye, one sword, and a ruthlessness that terrified entire clans. But history had already moved on without him.
